collection.title: Audi A5 Coupe 2007 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Audi A5 Coupe 2007 Only model - which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
